description: Verify that UDP receive operations return the data octets correctly to the upper layer (RFC 768 'User Interface' MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
The receive primitive must hand the application byte-exact payload — no truncation, no reorder, no off-by-one. This case sends a UDP with a known payload pattern and asks DUT to echo what it saw.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: UDP datagram with a known payload P
2. Tester → DUT: OpGetReceivedUdp UT-query

3. Observation:
   • UT Confirmation reports payload bytes == P   ← key check

[Pass condition]
Reported payload bytes match what was sent.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_field_mismatch — DUT reported wrong payload bytes
• Fail_timeout — UT-query never returned

verdicts.Pass: DUT reported correct payload bytes — normal
verdicts.Fail_field_mismatch: DUT received UDP with wrong payload bytes
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No UT confirmation for payload check
